Independent ./review-evidence/radix.js replay (node /workspace/review-evidence/radix.js): for min A and max B, the complete-block quotient gives A(n)=floor(n/k)−B(floor(n/k)) and B(n)=ceil(n/k)−A(ceil(n/k)) for n≥2. Indeed length n windows project to either floor or ceil(n/k) block-end letters, each admissible length can start at every nonnegative projected position, and l−A(l) and l−B(l) are nondecreasing. Compared these independent extrema with literal substitution prefixes for all n=1,…,140 in k=3,…,8 (840 comparisons); checked both special sequences via this recurrence for exponents 1,…,8 in each radix. All checks passed.
correctness.rationale: The fixed point records the parity of the exponent of k dividing j+1, also for composite k. Counting multiples and collecting radix digits gives the displayed prefix identity. In the difference across an addition, the column identity a_j+c_j−kc_(j+1) contributes (k+1)(−1)^(j+1)c_j for each carry at position j≥1 after summation, giving precisely the weight claimed. The local inequalities allow arbitrary compatible column choices; finite paths are realized by finite starts. Beyond the leading digit an incoming one persists for a run and stops, and the two alternating-tail corrections are attained. Thus the constant-state dynamic program finds two attained extrema per length, and one-step changes in overlapping windows give every intervening integer. For the alternating digit ladder, every negatively signed carry pairs with the immediately preceding positive carry, including in the tail, and the tail cannot increase the m contributions available up through the highest relevant position. Taking M=0 and M equal to the sum of powers at the nonzero digits gives the extrema zero and m. For m=1 this gives exactly two counts. Primitivity holds at the second iterate. The prefix identity gives frequency 1/(k+1) and unbounded discrepancy along integers with arbitrarily many nonzero digits all at even positions, ruling out even eventual periodicity. The repaired operation count is in integer operations, not a bit-cost assertion.
residual_risks: The finite replay is corroboration; the universal carry proof uses explicit attainability and the alternating-tail argument. The reported frozen test count is not a fresh run.
